flowContents.name: NetSuite Modified Employees
flowContents.comments: Multi-mode NetSuite employee query flow (EMP_ID, EMP_EMAIL, MODIFIED last N days, or ALL). Pages through results and emits one JSON array per page (up to #{ns.page.size} employees) on output port 'Employee Records'.

processors.name: Trigger Run
processors.comments: Primary Node, 1 task. Initializes batch.id, ns.cutoff, ns.offset, ns.page, and query mode attributes from Parameter Context.

processors.name: Select Query Mode
processors.comments: Routes to EMP_ID, EMP_EMAIL, ALL, or defaults (unmatched) to MODIFIED (last N days).

processors.name: Build Query: By EMP ID
processors.comments: Option 1: Queries specific employee record matching internal id or entityid (${ns.emp.id}).

properties.Replacement Value: {"q": "SELECT #{ns.employee.columns} FROM employee WHERE (TO_CHAR(id) = '${ns.emp.id:replace("'", "''")}' OR LOWER(entityid) = LOWER('${ns.emp.id:replace("'", "''")}')) #{ns.employee.filter} ORDER BY id"}

processors.name: Build Query: By EMP Email
processors.comments: Option 2: Queries specific employee record matching email (${ns.emp.email}).

properties.Replacement Value: {"q": "SELECT #{ns.employee.columns} FROM employee WHERE LOWER(email) = LOWER('${ns.emp.email:replace("'", "''")}') #{ns.employee.filter} ORDER BY id"}

processors.name: Build Query: Modified Last N Days
processors.comments: Option 3 (Default): Queries employees modified in the last #{ns.lookback.days} days (default 50).

properties.Replacement Value: {"q": "SELECT #{ns.employee.columns} FROM employee WHERE lastmodifieddate >= TO_DATE('${ns.cutoff}', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') #{ns.employee.filter} ORDER BY id"}

processors.name: Build Query: All Employees
processors.comments: Option 4: Queries all employee records (paginated by #{ns.page.size} up to #{ns.max.pages}).

properties.Replacement Value: {"q": "SELECT #{ns.employee.columns} FROM employee WHERE 1=1 #{ns.employee.filter} ORDER BY id"}

processors.name: Retry Query (re-sign)
processors.comments: 5xx / connection errors loop back through the signer so every attempt gets a fresh nonce.

processors.name: Route Page
processors.comments: has_more -> emit this page AND fetch the next one; unmatched = last page with data.

processors.name: Next Page Offset
processors.comments: Increments ns.offset and ns.page, then loops back to Select Query Mode to rebuild the active query body.

processors.name: Extract Employee Records
processors.comments: Content becomes a JSON array of employee objects (SuiteQL values are strings; booleans are T/F).

properties.Log Message: NetSuite employee query ${batch.id} (mode=${ns.query.mode}): 0 matching employees found
NetSuite employee query ${batch.id} stopped after #{ns.max.pages} pages (${ns.total} matching employees) - raise ns.max.pages

outputPorts.name: Employee Records
outputPorts.comments: One FlowFile per page: JSON array of employees. Connect to any consumer process group.

NetSuite Modified Employees Parameters.name: NetSuite Modified Employees Parameters
NetSuite Modified Employees Parameters.description: Configure TBA secrets and select ns.query.mode (EMP_ID, EMP_EMAIL, MODIFIED, or ALL).

parameters.name: ns.account.realm
parameters.description: OAuth realm = NetSuite account ID (upper case, underscore)

parameters.name: ns.account.subdomain
parameters.description: Account ID in the SuiteTalk host name (lower case, hyphen)

parameters.name: ns.query.mode
parameters.description: Query mode: EMP_ID, EMP_EMAIL, MODIFIED (last N days), or ALL

parameters.name: ns.emp.id
parameters.description: Employee internal ID or entityid (used when ns.query.mode = EMP_ID)

parameters.name: ns.emp.email
parameters.description: Employee email address (used when ns.query.mode = EMP_EMAIL)

parameters.name: ns.lookback.days
parameters.description: Employees whose lastmodifieddate is within the last N days (used when ns.query.mode = MODIFIED)

parameters.name: ns.employee.columns
parameters.description: SuiteQL column list from the employee table (no double quotes)
parameters.value: id, entityid, firstname, lastname, email, title, department, location, subsidiary, supervisor, isinactive, hiredate, datecreated, lastmodifieddate

parameters.name: ns.employee.filter
parameters.description: Optional extra SuiteQL condition, e.g. AND isinactive = 'F' (no double quotes)

parameters.name: ns.max.pages
parameters.description: Safety stop: maximum pages per run
